Sure thing! My name’s Noah Patel, and my zip code is 10108. I’m drawing a blank on my email address at the moment (classic me), but hopefully that’s enough to get us started. 

As for the order ID… I’ll need to dig that up. Where can I usually find it? Is it in the order confirmation or shipping email?

Alright, thanks for looking me up! I’ll go on a little digital scavenger hunt for that order ID—should be somewhere in my emails or maybe in my account order history. 

While I’m searching, just to double-check: once you have the order ID, you’ll be able to tell me which items are the office ones, right? I honestly can’t remember exactly what I ordered for work versus hiking (my brain’s still in “work from home” mode).

Perfect, thanks for confirming! I’ll go dig up that order ID and get back to you. My memory’s not what it used to be—too many spreadsheets, not enough trail mix, you know? I’ll be back in a jiffy with the info you need.

Thanks for being so chill about it! I found the right one this time: #7789-XY12. Hopefully, this is the magic number you need. Can you check which items are the office ones and let me know what my refund would be if I return just those? And, of course, I’d want the refund to go back to my original payment method. Thanks again for your help!

Oh boy, I must be on a roll with these mystery numbers! Maybe I should stick to hiking trails instead of tracking order IDs. I’ll take another look and see if I can spot the right one in my emails or account. If I can’t find it, is there any other way to look up my order using my name and zip code? Or do I absolutely need that order ID?

Got it, thanks for explaining! I’ll do a deep dive into my inbox and see if I can finally spot the right order ID. If I can’t find it, I’ll just let it go and keep everything—maybe my living room will become the most over-prepared home office in New York! 

Oh, and one more thing—if I end up keeping the order, could you help me update my default address to my parents’ place in Seattle? It’s the one I used for this order, but I’d rather not type it out here. Is that possible?

That sounds good! I’ll try one last time to find the order ID, but if it stays lost in the digital wilderness, I’ll just keep everything and circle back to you about the address update. Thanks for being so patient with me—clearly, I need a GPS for my inbox! 

I’ll reach out again if I find the order ID or need help with the address. Appreciate your help! 

###STOP###
